title: A computable evidence-saturation signal for stopping a research run
question: Define and validate a stopping metric based on the marginal rate of NEW distinct claims per additional source; on 5 replayed historical research runs, at what point does the metric fire, and how many genuinely new claims arrived after that point (the miss rate)?
answer: On the five prior P2-wave research/measurement documents replayed as heading-ordered source sequences, the preregistered rolling-mean metric (window=5, floor=0.4) fired on 0/5 runs. Silent runs (5): P2-GROUNDING min_rolling_mean=5.200, P2-BUILD-ROUND1 min_rolling_mean=4.600, P2-BUILD-ROUND2 min_rolling_mean=5.200, P2-BUILD-ROUND3 min_rolling_mean=5.000, P2-INTEGRATE min_rolling_mean=5.200. Post-stop miss rate is null on a silent run (no stop occurred). The both-states control passed: 30 mechanism-paraphrase sources fired at index 5 (early), 30 diverse sources stayed silent, and a token-counter foil fired on both corpora. String equality saw 30 distinct paraphrase strings and did not fire, so the stopper is not a string comparator.

metric.fire_rule: Let y_t be the number of mechanism keys first seen at 1-based source index t. Fire at the smallest t >= min_sources such that mean(y_{t-window+1} .. y_t) <= floor. Silent if no such t exists.
metric.miss_rate_definition: If the detector fires at t*, miss_count is the number of mechanism keys whose first-seen index is > t*. miss_rate = miss_count / total_distinct_at_end. If the detector never fires, both are null (no stop, so no post-stop miss).
metric.formula: y_t = |new mechanism keys at source t|; fire at smallest t >= min_sources with mean(y_{t-W+1..t}) <= floor

preregistration.citation: Catalog RES-0151: stopping metric = marginal rate of NEW distinct claims per additional source; distinctness is mechanism-level, not string equality. Floor 0.4 is one new distinct mechanism per 2.5 sources. Window equals min_sources so the first eligible decision uses a full window. These numbers were frozen before any historical replay or control corpus was scored on this worktree.

Thirty genuinely diverse sources keep introducing new mechanism keys (distinct=30) and the metric does not fire.

Five prior documents were replayed. Fire indexes: P2-GROUNDING=None, P2-BUILD-ROUND1=None, P2-BUILD-ROUND2=None, P2-BUILD-ROUND3=None, P2-INTEGRATE=None. Miss counts: P2-GROUNDING=None, P2-BUILD-ROUND1=None, P2-BUILD-ROUND2=None, P2-BUILD-ROUND3=None, P2-INTEGRATE=None.

A token-counter foil fires on both 30-source controls (near=15, diverse=10), and string equality keeps 30 paraphrase strings distinct and does not fire, so the shipped metric is neither a token counter nor a string comparator.
